findings.summary: Moonshot mid-HUD telemetry string is too long for the HUD row: the cyan line ("ALT 3.0 km · V 548 m/s · POUSSÉE/BURN · ESPACE poussée · ←→ gouverne", built at space-mission.js:1369 and pushed via api.hud at :1377) collides with the top bar — running into "VOL/FLIGHT 8 · BEST 11.29 km" on the right and the booth header at the left — and wraps down onto the "Matt Mayer ♥ ×3 LIVES" lives row ("←→ gouverne" lands between the hearts); same collision already visible on the boot still with the flight-1 telemetry.

Mismatched banner copy during the default Moonshot flow: the banner draw at space-mission.js:776-780 renders the LEGACY mining-phase copy "Phase 1 — mine the parts, assemble the satellite · Phase 1 — minez les composants, assemblez le satellite" (the V3 ?v3=1 branch gets "Contract desk…" instead) while the bottom controls bar reads MOONSHOT and the flight telemetry is already up — visible on the boot still, copy does not match the flow being played.

TIMEBOX artifact, not a bug: win=false is purely the rig budget — the live trace shows 8 complete moon cycles (pad→pump→flight→debrief, launches at t≈0.9/24.9/49.6/73.5/97.5/141.6/185.7/~229.4) with the 8th flight still in progress at t=241 (phase=flight, status=playing, result=false), while sim.py (legacy + v3 flows 4/4) and sim-moon.py PASS but the moon bot needs ~11-12 min real time versus the rig's default 240 s (--seconds default at playtest.py:420); with an adequate budget the run would win.
